title: Warhammer maker Games Workshop says it banned its staff from using AI in its content or designs and it is taking a "very cautious" approach to protect its IP (Philip Stafford/Financial Times)
summary: Philip Stafford / Financial Times: Warhammer maker Games Workshop says it banned its staff from using AI in its content or designs and it is taking a “very cautious” approach to protect its IP — Group behind Warhammer taking ‘very cautious’ approach and says it will ‘respect our human creators’
contentText:
Philip Stafford / Financial Times :

Warhammer maker Games Workshop says it banned its staff from using AI in its content or designs and it is taking a “very cautious” approach to protect its IP   —  Group behind Warhammer taking ‘very cautious’ approach and says it will ‘respect our human creators’
